description: Address code review issues: fix dynamic-type emit gap in math/random modules, remove intBinarySymbol factory, add documentation comments, and add runtime error integration tests.
steps: Fix issue #1: Add dynamic dispatch emit paths for math/random functions when argument type is Any (TypeRef at VM level)
Fix issue #2: Remove intBinarySymbol factory, inline two separate NewSymbol calls in New()
Fix issue #3: Add comment documenting that seed() is process-global
Fix issue #5: Add comment in math.go noting ceil/floor return float not int (deviation from CPython)
Fix issue #6: Add integration tests for runtime error paths: factorial(-1), reduce empty list, randrange(0), randrange(5,3), choice([])
Fix issue #7: Add comment documenting sys.exit behavior as hard halt
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic-typed math/random inputs emit correct VM code with runtime type dispatch
Documentation comments are added for global RNG state, ceil/floor deviation, and sys.exit behavior
Runtime error path tests are present and passing
